auth.headline: Install small. Run your backend with confidence.
auth.description: Peanut brings the backend pieces your apps need into one place: auth, data, files, functions, push, and operations on infrastructure you control.
auth.signalOps: See operational health at a glance
auth.featureAuthDescription: Manage users, sessions, and social login per app.
auth.featureDataDescription: Create and edit JSON tables and rows directly from the console.
auth.featureStorageDescription: Control buckets, objects, public reads, and upload policy.
auth.featureFunctionsDescription: Write and test server functions exposed as HTTP endpoints.
auth.featurePushDescription: Inspect subscriptions, queue test messages, and track delivery health.
auth.featureOpsDescription: Check readiness, backups, usage, and runtime diagnostics in one view.
auth.freshInstallHelp: Use this once on a fresh Peanut install.
auth.signInHelp: Sign in with a platform admin account.
auth.rememberMeHelp: Keep this browser signed in after reopening it.
auth.adminExists: An admin already exists. Please sign in.

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.description: A quick read on isolation, runtime readiness, and recent activity.

apps.emptyDescription: Peanut isolates Auth, Data, Storage, Functions, and Push by app.
apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Each app has isolated users, tables, buckets, functions, push subscriptions, and keys.
apps.editDescription: Change the app display name. The app ID and internal name stay the same.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create least-privilege keys for clients, servers, and admin automation.
keys.created: Key created. Use the copy button to retrieve the full key.
keys.newKeyHelp: For security, the full key is not shown on screen. Copy it before leaving this screen and store it safely.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke {name}? Revoked keys cannot be used again.
keys.rotated: Key rotated. Use the copy button to retrieve the full key.
keys.confirmRotate: Rotate {name}? The existing key value changes immediately.

authView.title: Auth
authView.description: Manage app-scoped users, sessions, OIDC providers, and security events.

dataView.title: Data
dataView.description: Create JSON-backed tables for the app and inspect row data.
dataView.name: Name

storageView.title: Storage
storageView.description: Manage bucket policies and objects for app-scoped files.
storageView.name: Name

functionsView.title: Functions
functionsView.description: Create, test, invoke, restore versions, and retry app-scoped functions.
functionsView.endpointHelp: Invocation URL built from the current browser host.
functionsView.name: Name
functionsView.nameHelp: Internal function identifier used by the console and API. Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are recommended.
functionsView.displayNameHelp: Human-friendly name shown in lists and the editor.
functionsView.endpointSlugHelp: Last segment of the HTTP invocation URL, for example hello-console.
functionsView.runtimeHelp: Language runtime used to execute the function code.
functionsView.runtimeSettingsHelp: Execution settings such as invocation policy, timeout, and enabled state.
functionsView.invokePolicyHelp: Controls who can call the function. Public allows open calls, authenticated requires a user, and API key requires a key.
functionsView.timeoutHelp: Maximum execution time before the function is stopped.
functionsView.stateHelp: Disable the function to block endpoint invocation without deleting it.
functionsView.leftRailHint: Selecting a function fills the editor with its latest settings and source.
functionsView.codeHelp: The default export receives the request context and returns the response object.
functionsView.executionResultHelp: Lint, dry-run, invoke, and retry responses appear here.
functionsView.testEventHelp: Actual HTTP request body. When you pass { "input": ... }, that input value becomes ctx.request.input.
functionsView.httpMethodHelp: Request method used when invoking the endpoint.
functionsView.queryParamsHelp: JSON object converted to the URL query string. Example: { "page": 1 }
functionsView.requestBodyHelp: When you pass { "input": ... }, that input value becomes ctx.request.input.

pushView.title: Push
pushView.description: Inspect subscription health, queue pressure, and delivery diagnostics.

activityView.title: Activity
activityView.description: A single app-scoped feed for auth, data, storage, functions, push, and key changes.
activityView.emptyDescription: Changes will appear here as the app is used.

opsView.title: Operations
opsView.description: Review single-node production checks, backup posture, schema invariants, and service health.
opsView.confirmScheduleRestore: Schedule restore from {name} on next restart?
